Timeline

A Timeline for Retrograde (Subject to change)

Last updated: 10/10/26

The Exodus Era

Year 0

Humanity abandons Earth after centuries of environmental collapse.

The Colonial Era

Year 1–30

Hundreds of colony ships arrive on Zenith, establishing settlements across the planet.

Year 8

The earliest permanent human settlements are established.

Year 40–80

Humans begin documenting Zenith's unfamiliar flora and fauna.

Year 70–95

Growing competition over land, resources, and trade creates tensions between human settlements.

The Great Zenith War

Year 96

Open warfare breaks out between competing human factions.

Year 110

Researchers discover that the powerful native creatures later known as Moon Children possess highly energetic internal cores.

Year 130

The first Signature is created from a stabilized Moon Child core.

Year 130–180

Signatures are developed and used by competing factions. Moon Children are hunted extensively for their cores.

Year 188

The First Human War ends after decades of conflict, leaving much of early human civilization destroyed.

The Unity Era

Year 190–250

Human settlements rebuild and reorganize following the war.

Year 215–280

Knowledge of Signature creation becomes increasingly fragmented and eventually lost.

Year 300

The last known Moon Children are believed to have been killed.

Year 320

Moon Children are considered extinct, making new Signatures impossible to create.

The Zone Era

Year 330–380

Major settlements begin developing large-scale environmental control systems to protect their populations from Zenith's wilderness.

Year 360

The earliest recognizable Zones are established.

Year 370–450

Zones expand and their governments gain increasing political and economic authority.

Year 440

Several Zone governments begin developing into the organizations that will eventually become the Monoliths.

The Enterprise Era

Year 460–550

The emerging Monoliths consolidate control over major industries, infrastructure, and government.

Year 570–700

Monolith-controlled companies expand beyond their home Zones, bringing major industries under increasingly centralized corporate control.

Year 650–700

The 24 Monoliths become the dominant political and economic powers on Zenith.

The Monolithic Era

Year 700–850

Monoliths expand their influence over transportation, communications, healthcare, education, manufacturing, and other major industries.

Year 820–880

Inter-Zone transportation, communication, and commerce become increasingly important.

Year 850–900

The Monolith system becomes deeply established across Zenith.

The Terminal Era

Year 900

The social, economic, and political systems recognizable in modern Zenith become firmly established.

Year 930–980

Continued industrial development causes increasing environmental damage outside the Zones.

Year 950

The Pale becomes increasingly difficult for ordinary humans to inhabit.

Year 999

Year 999

Signs of instability begin to emerge around the Zone barriers.
